title: Open: distinct layer 5 classes may serve the two loops

statements.text: If distinct classes of layer 5 neurons serve the cortico-cortical and the cortico-thalamo-cortical loops, it is unclear that the two loops intersect at all. The authors note that direct evidence for long-range cortical input onto the apical dendrites of layer 5B neurons is scarce.

sources.quote: is it even meaningful to suggest that there is an intersection of these loops?
We note that the direct evidence for this last claim is scarce
